The structure of your will can significantly impact the amount of inheritance tax you pay. There are several techniques that can be used to minimize your tax liability, but the best approach will depend on your specific circumstances.

* **Granting a life estate:** A life estate allows you to transfer ownership of property to another person (usually a family member) during your lifetime. **1. Rest and Hydration:**
- Get plenty of rest and drink plenty of fluids to stay hydrated. Dehydration can cause headaches.

- Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs), such as ibuprofen or acetaminophen, can help reduce inflammation and pain.
